method: Fresh built-in GPT Image attempts (lead-run Sol lane) from real-palette native 8x pose references, the owner-approved powered concept, the model sheet and approved normal sprites; fixed anatomical scale per image; mode filter of a third of a native pixel, then centre (nearest) sampling at the grid phase with the most uniform samples; palette-role indexing; ink bounding plates/plumage and the outer silhouette joins contour slot 2; single-pixel material despeckle. Slopes derived with derive_slopes.derive at the replaced frames' support distance. The transformation flash beat is re-indexed onto fixed white/cream/tan roles (native $6F/$D4 flash silhouettes ignore the palette fade); detached specks of 3 px or fewer are dropped. MICA run boots are repainted to her sheet boot (boot_repaint). No native pixels shipped.
selection: MICA: regen wait v2, regen run v1 (boots repainted), pilot roll v1, regen transformation v2. TALON: wait v2, run v2 (darker chest bars), roll v2, transformation v1 (pale wrapped first beat).

plan.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production 1990s Sega Genesis / Mega Drive sprite art, exactly like the native sprites in image 1: hard square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no glow, cel shading with two or three flat shade steps per material, light from the upper left, a dark one-pixel outline, at most 15 colours. Each sprite is drawn LARGE (about 8x) on a plain flat mid-grey background, one sprite per equal grid cell, no text, no labels, no numbers, no ground shadows, no rings, no effects or sparkles outside the body. He is TALON, an original peregrine-falcon courier (image 4 is his approved model sheet; image 5 is his approved in-game sprites at 8x and LOCKS his skull size, torso size and pixel style). Keep: yellow hooked beak, dark falcon moustache stripe under each eye, brown courier satchel on a strap across a cream chest barred with DARK stripes, white gloves on feathered wing-hands, red-and-white high-top shoes. His wings are part of his arms. REMOVE everything Tails has that TALON lacks: no fox tails, no rotor, no mast, no fox ears, no muzzle. No resemblance to Tails, Jet the Hawk or any Sega character. POWERED FORM 'SOLAR TALON', direction CORONA CREST, exactly as in images 2 and 3 (the owner-approved concept): his crest is THREE TALL FLAME-FEATHERS, broad at the base and curling at the tips; his amber aviator GOGGLES ARE PULLED DOWN OVER HIS EYES with glowing pale amber-white lenses; the three outer flight feathers of each wing are long FLAME-TIPPED BLADES and the tail fan has flame tips. Plumage white-gold with pale-gold shading; every flame tip grades white to amber to orange to a small red point. His chest bars and moustache stripe STAY DARK bronze/brown so he never becomes a pale blob; satchel brown, beak yellow, shoes red and white. Image 1 shows the native standing pose in its real game palette at 8x: top row S2 Tails frame $01, bottom row S3K Tails frame $AD (each shown twice). Draw FOUR sprites in the same 2x2 grid, each copying that native stance, facing and size, as a mantling raptor: wings held slightly open and low beside him. Within each row the two sprites are identical except the three crest flame-feathers FLICKER: left cell flames leaning back, right cell flames curled one pixel higher and further forward.
